dict.string: Brain Voice records a voice note, saves it into the Brain Outbox folder in Files, then sends everything waiting in that folder to your Brain Cockpit. If the send fails, the recording stays in the folder and goes out on the next run. Nothing is asked while it runs, so it works from the Action Button.

Shortcuts generated by Shortcuts Playground. May contain mistakes. Always check the shortcut's actions first.
This shortcut was created via the following user prompt:
> Brain Voice: Action Button voice note to Brain OS, offline-safe
Check the answer to the first import question - Condition checks the first Text action above - If it ends with a slash, a notification explains how to fix it and the shortcut stops
Your Brain address ends with a slash. That breaks every request. Delete this shortcut and re-import it, typing the address without the final /.

Get the audio to send - Condition checks whether Shortcut Input has any value, which lets you test with a file - If it has a value, Audio is set to the Shortcut Input - Otherwise Record Audio starts immediately and Audio is set to the Recorded Audio
Make a unique name for this recording - Two Random Number actions feed the Text action below - Text joins the two numbers with a dash

Save the recording to Brain Outbox before any network call - Input uses Audio - Destination Path uses the Text from the step above plus the m4a extension - Saving first means nothing is lost if the send fails
Send everything waiting in Brain Outbox
Go through every file waiting in Brain Outbox - Repeat with Each uses the Files from Get Contents of Folder - Repeat Item is the current file
Choose the upload route by file type - Condition checks the Text holding the file extension - m4a files go to the audio route - Anything else goes to the general capture route

Read the reply from the cockpit for the audio upload - Condition checks whether the Dictionary Value for id has a value - A value means the cockpit accepted the file, so the file is deleted and a notification confirms it

Handle a reply that is not a success - Condition checks whether the Dictionary Value for error has a value - If it does, a notification shows what happened and what to do - Otherwise the cockpit did not answer properly and the file stays in Brain Outbox

Not sent — the cockpit didn't answer like the cockpit. Check the address has no trailing slash and isn't behind a login page. Your recording is kept in Files › Shortcuts › Brain Outbox and is sent automatically next run.

Read the reply from the cockpit for the general capture upload - Condition checks whether the Dictionary Value for id has a value - A value means the cockpit accepted the file, so the file is deleted and a notification confirms it

Handle a reply that is not a success for the general capture upload - Condition checks whether the Dictionary Value for error has a value - If it does, a notification shows what happened and what to do - Otherwise the cockpit did not answer properly and the file stays in Brain Outbox

Not sent — the cockpit didn't answer like the cockpit. Check the address has no trailing slash and isn't behind a login page. Your recording is kept in Files › Shortcuts › Brain Outbox and is sent automatically next run.
What is your Brain Cockpit address? Start with https and leave off any trailing slash.
Paste your Brain Cockpit access token (api.auth_token).
